name: Open Tools
description: A composer toolbar button that opens the current project folder in an external tool: an editor, the file manager, a terminal, a shell. Windows offers VS Code, File Explorer, Command Prompt, Windows PowerShell, PowerShell 7, Git Bash, Windows Terminal and WSL; macOS offers VS Code, Finder, Terminal and iTerm2; Linux offers VS Code, the file manager (xdg-open) and the usual terminal emulators. Every tool is probed on this machine, so only the ones really installed are listed, and a tool that is missing simply never appears. The list itself is yours: enable, disable, rename, re-argument, re-order, delete the built-in tools, or add a program of your own — all of it in one sheet behind the button, which is also the only place the list is edited. Launches never go through a shell: a fixed executable plus an argv array, with the project folder as one argument and as the working directory.
author: mfy

en.name: Open Tools
en.description: A composer toolbar button that opens the current project folder in an external tool, on Windows, macOS and Linux. The built-in tools are the ones that platform really has: on Windows VS Code, File Explorer, Command Prompt, Windows PowerShell, PowerShell 7, Git Bash, Windows Terminal and WSL; on macOS VS Code (through its command-line tool, or through the app when the command line is not installed), Finder, Terminal and iTerm2; on Linux VS Code, the desktop file manager through xdg-open, and the terminal emulators that accept a working directory on their command line. Each tool is probed on this machine, so only the installed ones are listed. The button is greyed out with a reason when no project folder is open, and a failed launch is reported as a notification instead of failing silently. The tool list is fully yours: open the button's menu and pick 'Configure tools…' to enable, disable, rename, re-argument or re-order the built-in tools, delete one, or add a program of your own (an absolute path plus an argv array that mentions {dir} exactly once; on Windows the path must name a .exe). That sheet is the only editor — this plugin declares no setting, so the plugin manager has no second, raw-JSON copy of the same list.
en.safetyNotes: The plugin declares renderer.extension (one composer toolbar button) and notify (the failure notification). It asks for no file, network, agent, clipboard or MCP permission, reads and writes no project file and opens no connection. The one thing it writes is its own tool list, a small JSON file inside the plugin data directory the host hands over with pi.plugin.getDataPath(); the write goes to a temporary file and is renamed into place. Detection only stats a fixed list of install locations plus the directories already on PATH, and its result is cached in memory for one minute. Every launch is a child_process.spawn with a fixed executable resolved by the plugin itself, shell: false, an argv array in which the project folder is one element, detached + stdio ignored so the tool outlives the plugin, and a whitelist of tool ids the renderer may name — the renderer can never pass an executable path or a directory, so there is no command-line injection surface. The child environment is completed per platform before anything is started: on Windows the standard variables (LOCALAPPDATA, APPDATA, USERNAME, …) the host strips from the plugin process are filled back in, because without them a GUI app cannot start and Windows Terminal cannot find its own settings; on macOS and Linux the Windows-only variables are dropped instead and HOME, USER, LOGNAME, SHELL and TMPDIR are completed the same careful way. Every completed value is either inherited or derived from the user profile and checked on disk first.

zh-CN.name: 外部工具
zh-CN.description: 在输入框工具栏放一个按钮，一键用外部工具打开当前项目文件夹，Windows、macOS、Linux 都支持。内置工具就是该系统上真实存在的那些：Windows 上是 VS Code、资源管理器、命令提示符、Windows PowerShell、PowerShell 7、Git Bash、Windows 终端、WSL；macOS 上是 VS Code（优先用它的命令行工具，没装命令行时走应用本体）、访达、终端、iTerm2；Linux 上是 VS Code、通过 xdg-open 打开的文件管理器，以及支持在命令行里指定工作目录的终端模拟器。每个工具都在本机真实探测，装了哪几个就列哪几个，没装的不会出现。没有打开项目时按钮置灰并说明原因；启动失败会弹通知，不会静默失败。菜单列表完全由你决定：启用、停用、改名、改参数、排序、删除内置工具，或者新增自己的程序——全部在那块「配置外部工具」面板里完成，它也是唯一能编辑列表的地方（自定义工具需要一个绝对路径和一份提到一次 {dir} 的参数表；Windows 上路径必须是 .exe）。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 插件只申请 renderer.extension（一个输入框工具栏按钮）与 notify（失败通知）。不申请文件、网络、agent、剪贴板、MCP 任何权限，不读写项目文件、不联网。唯一写盘的是它自己的工具列表：宿主通过 pi.plugin.getDataPath() 交给插件的数据目录里的一个小 JSON 文件；写法是先写临时文件再改名替换。探测只 stat 固定安装位置与 PATH 上已有的目录，结果只在内存里缓存一分钟。每次启动都是 child_process.spawn：可执行文件由插件自己解析，shell: false，项目文件夹作为 argv 数组中的一个元素、同时作为工作目录，detached + stdio ignore 让工具脱离插件独立存活；渲染器只能递交工具 id（白名单），永远递不了可执行文件路径或目录，因此没有命令注入面。启动前会按平台补全子进程环境：Windows 上把宿主裁掉的标准变量（LOCALAPPDATA、APPDATA、USERNAME 等）补回去，缺了它们 GUI 程序起不来、Windows 终端也找不到自己的设置；macOS 与 Linux 上反过来去掉 Windows 专有变量，并按同样谨慎的方式补全 HOME、USER、LOGNAME、SHELL、TMPDIR。补的每个值要么继承自宿主，要么由用户目录推导，并且先在磁盘上核实过。自定义工具的可执行文件由用户在面板里指定，因此额外要求绝对路径、文件确实存在（Windows 上还要求 .exe 后缀），且 argv 中「{dir}」必须独占一个元素；写错的条目被跳过而不是启动。
